title: Year in Review
description: A dispatcher builds a full month-by-month report across a wide window spanning several months of activity, checking that revenue and volume roll up faithfully at scale, not just for one or two shipments.
successCondition: Book at least 6 shipments spread across at least 3 distinct calendar months (UTC), with known priceCents for each (record them as you book). GET /api/reporting/summary with groupBy=month over a from/to window covering all of them returns totalShipments equal to the total count booked, totalRevenueCents equal to the exact sum of all their priceCents values, and a buckets array with one entry per distinct month containing shipments, each bucket's shipmentCount and revenueCents matching the manually-tallied per-month totals from your recorded bookings.
hints: Record each booking's createdAt and priceCents immediately after creating it — you'll need to manually group them by UTC month yourself to build the expected buckets to compare against.

If your environment has pre-existing shipment data in the same window, either pick a from/to range narrow enough to exclude it, or account for it explicitly in your expected totals rather than assuming a clean slate.
